typography.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider

pages_and_features.name: Landing Page
elements: Navigation bar with logo 'ReplyRush', links (Features, Issue Radar, Pricing), and 'Sign In' CTA button
Animated gradient hero with heading 'Never leave a review unanswered again'
3-Step Visual Process: 1. Connect Accounts, 2. AI Drafts Personalized Reply, 3. One-Click Copy
Interactive Mock Preview Card showing real-time review with simulated typing AI reply
Get Started CTA button leading to Login/Dashboard
Social proof badges and platform icons marquee

pages_and_features.name: Login Page
elements: Centered glassy backdrop card (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 shadow-2xl border border-white/50)
ReplyRush Logo + Tagline 'AI review & complaint assistant for local business owners'
White 'Sign in with Google' button with official multi-color G logo icon
Subtle animated vibrant gradient background layer
Demo quick-login bypass button for testing ease

pages_and_features.name: Dashboard
elements: Analytics Widget: Total Reviews Handled (animated counter), % Positive vs Negative Donut Chart (Recharts), Estimated Time Saved (e.g. '18.5 hrs')
Urgency Chips Filter bar (Red / Yellow / Green badges)
ISSUE RADAR Panel: Horizontal theme bars split by platform logo & trend arrows, pulsing 'Needs Attention' banner, side drawer with matching reviews + 1 suggested action
Five Platform Connection Cards: Google, Zomato, Amazon, Yelp, Instagram with platform brand colors, connection status, and 'Connect' / 'Manage' button

pages_and_features.name: Connect Flow
elements: 2-second simulated loading state with animated progress spinner & status text 'Fetching your latest reviews...'
Revealed seeded review cards styled with platform brand badges, star ratings, reviewer name, date, text, and urgency flag dot
Sorting logic: Red (High Urgency) items sort to top, followed by Yellow (Medium), then Green (Low)

pages_and_features.name: Reply Studio
elements: Business Type selector dropdown (Cafe, Restaurant, Salon, Retail, Dental, Hotel, etc.)
Tone selector pill buttons (Empathetic, Professional, Casual, Apologetic & Solution, Enthusiastic)
'What can you actually offer?' text input (e.g., '10% discount on next visit', 'Free espresso', 'Manager call')
Generate Reply button with sparkles icon
Editable response textarea with live word counter and tone indicator
Action buttons: Copy Reply (with Sonner toast notification), Regenerate button, and Direct Mark as Replied button

pages_and_features.name: History Page
elements: Structured table / list rows displaying platform logo, urgency flag color tag, review snippet, generated reply preview, date timestamp
Filterable controls by Platform (All, Google, Zomato, Amazon, Yelp, Instagram) and Urgency Flag (Red, Yellow, Green)
Search bar for keyword filtering within customer reviews and AI replies

motion_and_animations.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='connect-google-btn', data-testid='generate-reply-btn').
Use react-icons/si (SiGoogle, SiZomato, SiAmazon, SiYelp, SiInstagram) for all platform logos and render them in their exact brand colors.
Strictly maintain red, yellow, and green urgency color coding throughout the dashboard, connect flow, reply studio, and history list.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback when actions like 'Copy Reply', 'Connect Platform', or 'Save Settings' take place.
Implement smooth Framer Motion page transitions and card hover lift interactions across all 5 main pages.
